reasoning: The primary limiter is lactate clearance and aerobic base. Your last ride showed a moderate intensity but didn’t challenge your lactate threshold. suggested_sets.description: 3 sets of 12-min over-unders: 2 min at 242-256W, then 2 min at 201-218W, repeat 3 times with 3-min recovery at 150W between sets.
